description: This file implements an in-memory caching client for Kubernetes discovery API, providing cached access to server resources, groups, versions, and schema information, with cache invalidation and refresh capabilities.

classes.name: cacheEntry
classes.description: Holds a resource list and an error for cached server responses.

classes.name: memCacheClient
classes.description: In-memory cache implementation of Kubernetes discovery interface, supporting cache invalidation and refresh.

methods.name: ServerResourcesForGroupVersion
methods.description: Returns supported resources for a specific group and version, with cache refresh on transient errors.

methods.name: ServerGroupsAndResources
methods.description: Returns all server groups and resources.

methods.name: GroupsAndMaybeResources
methods.description: Returns server groups and optionally cached resources and errors.

methods.name: RESTClient
methods.description: Returns the REST client used by the delegate.

methods.name: ServerPreferredResources
methods.description: Returns preferred resources for the server.

methods.name: ServerPreferredNamespacedResources
methods.description: Returns preferred namespaced resources for the server.

methods.name: Fresh
methods.description: Checks if the cache is populated.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the cache, forcing refresh on next access.

methods.name: refreshLocked
methods.description: Refreshes cache data; must hold lock.

methods.name: serverResourcesForGroupVersion
methods.description: Fetches server resources for a specific group version, handling empty responses.

methods.name: WithLegacy
methods.description: Returns the current discovery client without legacy-only support.

methods.name: NewMemCacheClient
methods.description: Creates a new in-memory cached discovery client.
